run_mps_viewer_with_vrs: run the MPS data viewer by providing a path to a VRS file with --vrs
run_mps_viewer_with_trajectory: run the MPS viewer with trajectory files using the --trajectory argument
run_mps_viewer_with_eyegaze: run the MPS viewer with eye gaze data using the --eyegaze argument
run_mps_viewer_with_hand_tracking: run the MPS viewer with hand tracking data using --hands and --hands_all
run_mps_viewer_web_mode: run the MPS viewer in a web browser using the --web flag
